notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup. Wants hosted API (AWS) for quick POC. Primary concerns are around data privacy and retention — very specific Qs on log TTL, per-request opt-out, and whether prompts are persisted. Snippets from call: 
- "Can users opt out and have their prompts deleted immediately?" 
- "Do you keep prompt text in logs or only model input vectors?" 
- Concerned about customer promise: if a user requests deletion, how fast can we guarantee removal from all logs/backups?
- Asking for a per-tenant retention TTL and a deletion API they can call from their app.
- Wants to know whether Redwood supports a request header or flag (e.g. do_not_store) to prevent storage of prompts or KV caches.
- Legal asked about backups and how long transient logs (hot path) are retained vs long-term analytics.
- Technical: will be using chat + embeddings for support routing and doc search; expect low-latency chat (150-300ms target) and moderate embedding volume (~15k/month). Cost sensitivity high — SMB budget.
- Tried Redwood free tier; hit rate limits during spike and saw request logs in console — that visibility triggered legal questions.
- Quote from CTO: "We need an auditable deletion flow and a short retention default, otherwise our privacy policy is at risk."
- Wants an example dataflow diagram showing where prompts are stored, where logs are kept, and how deletion propagates to analytics snapshots.
- Interested in Optimize suggestions to reduce token cost but not at the expense of storing prompts longer.
- No SSO yet; will revisit if move to enterprise.
